props.text:
Can original July BTC targets (70k) still be reached? Believers looking to buy dips at 63.8k, expecting 67-69-71k progression if trendlines hold. Risk management key — early July longs slowly taking profits as targets hit.

Bear case: If more weakness comes, could see full retrace of July. No clear setup currently for new entries; will stick to LTF scalps until direction clarifies.
